title: Visible light-mediated 1,2-difunctionalization reactions involving 4-cyanopyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8206-8222
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09281G, Review Article

Pooya Raymand, Arman Farahani, Fatemeh Doraghi, Mohammad Hadi Edareh, Mehran Ghasemi, Mohammad Mahdavi
Due to producing persistent pyridyl radicals, 4-cyanopyridine is widely used in the decyanative pyridylation reactions towards C4-functionalized pyridine derivatives. This review highlights 1,2-difunctionalization reactions involving 4-cyanopyridine.
